subject: Lack of hm3 for crop samples

messages.author: 2fbef8095e8d22d6
messages.subject: Lack of hm3 for crop samples
parts:
Hi,

I'm new to GWAS and sorry for my naive question. I'm trying to do SEM-GWAS for crop metabolite data and I have used plink to do univariate GWAS to generate the summary statistics. I would like to generate genetic correlations between traits and conduct SEM-GWAS in one population of a crop, and based on the manual, the first step is to munge the summary statistics, but to do that I need a hm3 reference file, which I'm not sure how to generate. I have checked a few questions on the application of genomicSEM on non-human system, but I'm not sure if I can use the .bim file I used to run univariate GWAS as the reference file.

Thank you and look forward to your reply.

Song Shuang

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Lack of hm3 for crop samples
parts:
Hi Song, 

The reference file is just used to make sure that you are aligning the GWAS Z-statistics to the same reference allele across traits. So you could use your own in-house file so long as you use this same file for any other traits you include in the same model. 

Best, 
  Andrew
